[{"insert":"Low Incline DB Bench Press

The low incline dumbbell bench alternates with the flat bench across this cycle. The slight incline shifts more of the work onto the upper chest, while the dumbbells let each arm move on its own path, which is easier on the shoulders. Lower under control and press the dumbbells together at the top, saving enough for the max unbroken final set. Reps drop from Week 2 on this variation, so the weight goes up.
"}]
